title: 隧道二次襯砌台車施工~Tunnel secondary lining with formwork carriages
focus: 協調台車定位、新拌混凝土壓力與襯砌成形證據~Coordinate carriage position, fresh-concrete pressure and lining geometry evidence
summary: 本課以協調台車定位、新拌混凝土壓力與襯砌成形證據為主線，從淨空與襯砌厚度與新拌混凝土側壓建立系統邊界，再把不對稱壓力與上浮、早齡拆模與支承轉換連到台車循環與品質追溯。台車是施工階段構造，完成面淨空與結構厚度必須同時檢核。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。~This course focuses on coordinate carriage position, fresh-concrete pressure and lining geometry evidence. It begins with Clearance and lining thickness and Fresh-concrete lateral pressure, links Asymmetric pressure and uplift and Early stripping and support transfer, and ends with Carriage cycles and quality traceability. The carriage is a temporary structure; final clearance and structural thickness need simultaneous checks. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

units.anchor: 淨空與襯砌厚度~Clearance and lining thickness
units.title: 淨空與襯砌厚度~Clearance and lining thickness
units.mechanism: 台車定位同時決定內表面淨空與可用混凝土厚度，向外調整並非只有好處。初支輪廓不規則時，平均半徑合格仍可能局部不足；定位需把軌道基準、台車形狀與初支點雲配準，辨認真正最薄區而非只測拱頂高度。 判別這個機制時，應觀察把初支與模板點雲對齊到同一控制網並搜尋最小間距；若出現台車偏心增加一側淨空卻壓縮另一側結構厚度，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Carriage positioning sets both clearance and available concrete thickness, so moving outward is not purely beneficial. An irregular initial lining can leave thin zones despite a correct mean radius. Register track control, form geometry and initial-lining clouds to identify local minima rather than crown height alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Register support and form clouds to one network and locate minimum separation. If carriage eccentricity increases clearance on one side while consuming thickness on the other, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：thickness=outerRadius-innerRadius=5.30 m-5.00 m=0.30 m。台車是施工階段構造，完成面淨空與結構厚度必須同時檢核。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: thickness=outerRadius-innerRadius=5.30 m-5.00 m=0.30 m. The carriage is a temporary structure; final clearance and structural thickness need simultaneous checks. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.
units.verify: 把初支與模板點雲對齊到同一控制網並搜尋最小間距。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「台車偏心增加一側淨空卻壓縮另一側結構厚度」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。~Register support and form clouds to one network and locate minimum separation. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Carriage eccentricity increases clearance on one side while consuming thickness on the other. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to register support and form clouds to one network and locate minimum separation to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.
units.misconception: 內部淨空越大就表示襯砌品質越好~Greater interior clearance always means better lining quality
units.practice: 將把初支與模板點雲對齊到同一控制網並搜尋最小間距列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現台車偏心增加一側淨空卻壓縮另一側結構厚度，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。~Apply the following check at handover: Register support and form clouds to one network and locate minimum separation. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If carriage eccentricity increases clearance on one side while consuming thickness on the other, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 新拌混凝土側壓~Fresh-concrete lateral pressure
units.title: 新拌混凝土側壓~Fresh-concrete lateral pressure
units.mechanism: 新拌混凝土在凝結前會對模板產生側壓，壓力分布取決於流變、齡期和施工歷程。液體靜壓只是參考上界情境，不能把長期硬化混凝土當作同樣材料；模板、支架和地基應沿完整路徑傳遞這段短期作用。 判別這個機制時，應觀察量測模板壓力並對照混凝土溫度、齡期及填充高度；若出現誤用已凝結假設低估側壓，模板鼓脹造成輪廓失真，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Fresh concrete loads forms before setting, with pressure governed by rheology, age and placement history. Hydrostatic pressure is a reference scenario rather than hardened-concrete behaviour. Forms, frames and foundations must transfer this temporary action through a complete load path. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare form pressures with concrete temperature, age and fill height. If an assumed set state understates pressure and allows forms to bulge out of profile, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

The carriage is a temporary structure; final clearance and structural thickness need simultaneous checks. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

units.anchor: 面板跨距與撓度~Panel span and deflection
units.title: 面板跨距與撓度~Panel span and deflection
units.mechanism: 面板在肋材間彎曲，支承間距對變形極敏感；相同均布線荷載作用於較大未支承跨距，會增加局部鼓出。簡支條帶的跨度四次方關係須保持線荷載 q、EI 與支承條件不變；固定總力不是同一假設。實際板還有雙向剛度與接頭，不能只靠平均模板厚度判斷。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較肋距、面板中心位移與接縫兩側的高差；若出現局部缺肋讓面板撓度增加，形成難以修正的襯砌凹凸，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Panels bend between ribs and are highly sensitive to support spacing. The same uniform line load over a longer unsupported span increases bulging. Fourth-power span scaling requires unchanged line load q, EI and support conditions; fixed total force is a different assumption. Actual panels add two-way action and joints beyond mean plate thickness. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare rib spacing, panel-centre displacement and steps across seams. If a missing rib increases local deflection and creates permanent lining irregularity, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 支架反力與地基承壓~Frame reactions and foundation bearing
units.title: 支架反力與地基承壓~Frame reactions and foundation bearing
units.mechanism: 模板荷載經支架傳到支腳或軌道，偏心填充可能讓某些支腳先受力或局部抬起。總重量平均分配只適用理想對稱，基底柔度會重新分配反力；檢查應同時包含支架力、接觸狀態及基準沉陷。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將支腳荷重、底板接觸與軌道水準同步比較；若出現一支腳沉陷讓相鄰支架超載，台車整體產生扭曲，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Form loads reach feet or rails through the frame, while asymmetric filling can load some feet first or lift others. Equal distribution assumes symmetry; foundation compliance redistributes reactions. Verify frame forces, contact status and datum settlement together rather than total weight alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare foot loads, bearing contact and rail levels on a common time base. If one settling foot overloads neighbouring supports and twists the carriage, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 不對稱壓力與上浮~Asymmetric pressure and uplift
units.title: 不對稱壓力與上浮~Asymmetric pressure and uplift
units.mechanism: 混凝土壓力作用在模板不同方向，垂直分量可能產生上浮，水平不平衡則推動台車。只核對自重不能證明穩定，約束位置與反力容量必須配合實際載入階段；局部脫離支腳後，原先線性分配也會改變。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較台車垂直位移、支腳接觸和約束荷重歷程；若出現壓力不平衡抬起一側，使模板接縫張開與漏漿，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Pressure acts in different directions, generating uplift or lateral imbalance. Self-weight alone does not establish stability; restraint positions and reactions must match the stage. Once a foot separates, the assumed linear distribution changes and requires a revised contact model. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare vertical carriage motion, foot contact and restraint-force histories. If unbalanced pressure lifts one side, opening form joints and releasing grout, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 拱頂填充與空洞~Crown filling and voids
units.title: 拱頂填充與空洞~Crown filling and voids
units.mechanism: 拱頂是氣體與未填滿空間容易聚集的位置，出料量足夠不代表所有高點密實。理論體積與送入量的差也包含管路殘留、超挖和漏漿，不能直接等同空洞；應以多種證據區分幾何偏差與真正未填區。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照材料收支、拱頂檢測與可取得的孔內或雷達證據；若出現拱頂空洞削弱接觸並集中彎曲，外表平順仍可能漏判，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Air and unfilled space collect at high points; adequate delivery does not prove a dense crown. Theoretical-versus-delivered volume also includes line residue, overbreak and leakage. Combine evidence to distinguish geometric differences from actual voids instead of treating the balance residual as a direct void measurement. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare material balance with crown checks and available borehole or radar evidence. If a crown void weakens contact and concentrates bending despite a smooth interior, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 早齡拆模與支承轉換~Early stripping and support transfer
units.title: 早齡拆模與支承轉換~Early stripping and support transfer
units.mechanism: 拆模把混凝土自重及外力轉交給尚在硬化的襯砌，試件強度要能代表現地齡期與溫度。強度之外還有模數、裂縫及接觸條件，單一抗壓值不能證明整環穩定；支承轉換應明確納入施工階段模型。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將原位成熟度、可比試件及拆模後裂縫觀察配對；若出現暖室試件高估現地強度，支承撤除後形成早齡裂紋，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Stripping transfers self-weight and external actions to hardening lining, so specimens must represent in-place age and temperature. Modulus, cracks and contact matter as well as compression strength. One strength value cannot establish ring stability; model the support transition explicitly. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Pair in-place maturity and representative specimens with post-stripping crack observations. If warm specimens overstate field strength and early cracks form after support removal, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 溫度收縮與約束裂縫~Thermal contraction and restrained cracking
units.title: 溫度收縮與約束裂縫~Thermal contraction and restrained cracking
units.mechanism: 水化升溫後的降溫使襯砌收縮，初支、底部或相鄰段可能限制其自由變形。完全約束公式只是一個上限模型，徐變與接觸滑移會降低應力；監測需把溫度梯度與整體降溫分開，避免將所有裂縫都歸因於強度不足。 判別這個機制時，應觀察同步量測核心與表面溫度、應變及裂縫出現時刻；若出現只看最高溫度漏掉降溫約束，延後才發現貫通裂縫，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Cooling after hydration contracts lining against restraint from initial support, the base or adjacent pours. Full restraint is an upper-bound model reduced by creep and slip. Separate thermal gradients from bulk cooling instead of attributing every crack to low strength. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Synchronize core and surface temperatures, strain and crack-onset times. If peak-temperature checks miss cooling restraint and through-cracks are discovered late, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 施工縫對接與止水連續~Construction joints and waterstop continuity
units.title: 施工縫對接與止水連續~Construction joints and waterstop continuity
units.mechanism: 台車循環形成分段施工縫，接縫需要在幾何、剪力與止水三方面連續。止水帶偏位可能在澆置後被完全遮蔽，外表縫線整齊也無法證明埋入長度；前後兩段資料應共同索引到同一接縫編號。 判別這個機制時，應觀察檢查止水帶位置、固定狀態及兩段施工前後影像；若出現止水帶偏折形成漏水捷徑，表面接縫看不出缺陷，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Carriage cycles create joints requiring geometric, shear and hydraulic continuity. A displaced waterstop becomes concealed after casting, and a neat visible line does not establish embedment. Index records from both adjacent pours to the same joint identifier. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check waterstop position, restraint and images before and after both pours. If a folded waterstop creates a leakage shortcut invisible at the surface joint, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 台車循環與品質追溯~Carriage cycles and quality traceability
units.title: 台車循環與品質追溯~Carriage cycles and quality traceability
units.mechanism: 同一台車會重複移動、調整和受載，螺接鬆動或幾何漂移可能逐循環累積。出廠合格只描述初始設備，不代表每次定位正確；交接須把台車版本、定位檢查與各襯砌段的材料和缺陷關聯，讓系統性偏差可被辨認。 判別這個機制時，應觀察用每循環定位殘差與設備檢查紀錄分析累積偏差；若出現持續小偏位在多循環後侵入淨空，單次目視卻未察覺，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Repeated moves, adjustments and loads accumulate loosened connections and geometric drift. Factory acceptance describes initial equipment rather than each setup. Link carriage revisions and positioning checks to lining batches and defects so systematic errors can be recognized across cycles. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Analyze accumulated setup residuals alongside equipment inspection records. If small repeated offsets eventually encroach on clearance while individual visual checks miss them, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

example: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查淨空與襯砌厚度：thickness=outerRadius-innerRadius=5.30 m-5.00 m=0.30 m；再獨立檢查新拌混凝土側壓：p=gamma*h=24 kN/m3*3 m=72 kPa。外半徑 5.30 m 固定，台車內半徑由 5.00 增為 5.05 m，襯砌厚度由 0.30 降為 0.25 m，減少 16.7%；淨空增加會消耗結構厚度。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為台車是施工階段構造，完成面淨空與結構厚度必須同時檢核。 將同步量測核心與表面溫度、應變及裂縫出現時刻作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。~All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Clearance and lining thickness: thickness=outerRadius-innerRadius=5.30 m-5.00 m=0.30 m. Independently check Fresh-concrete lateral pressure: p=gamma*h=24 kN/m3*3 m=72 kPa. At a fixed outer radius of 5.30 m, increasing form radius from 5.00 to 5.05 m reduces thickness from 0.30 to 0.25 m, by 16.7%; increased clearance consumes structural thickness. The two results are not a complete design because the carriage is a temporary structure; final clearance and structural thickness need simultaneous checks. Use synchronize core and surface temperatures, strain and crack-onset times as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
history: 本課討論的協調台車定位、新拌混凝土壓力與襯砌成形證據，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。台車是施工階段構造，完成面淨空與結構厚度必須同時檢核。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。哥達與英法海底隧道僅作地質及地下水邊界的比較，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。~The focus on coordinate carriage position, fresh-concrete pressure and lining geometry evidence reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. The carriage is a temporary structure; final clearance and structural thickness need simultaneous checks. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Gotthard and the Channel Tunnel are comparisons of geological and groundwater boundaries only. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.
